comment: nodes: entries are https://host or {"url": "https://host", "tip": "https://host:16490/lc/tip"} (light-client nodes the site may use; the browser takes https only; tip = where the node serves its tip stream when that is not <url>/lc/tip: sm64coin-lc serve --tls-cert on its own HTTPS port). url is for clients older than the nodes list. The apps also learn more nodes from Monero's get_public_nodes.
